meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让一支敌对的多智能体团队在你把方案定稿前互相挑刺，提前暴露致命漏洞。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果重大方案即将拍板,你想在定稿前被彻底挑刺。
copy.tagline_en: Have adversarial agents cross-critique your plan before you lock it down.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a high-stakes plan is about to be locked and you want it stress-tested first.

howto.what: Claude 会当领队,组建 5 名互相攻击的成员团队,对你给的议题做交叉批判,只保留扛住攻击的可辩护结论,再交给专门的规划器写成正式方案。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或你要求 hyperplan、对抗式、交叉批判式规划时触发。需 omo-senpi 团队工具可用,且当前为顶层 lead 会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 对抗式评审这份上线方案
say.note: 先启动 5 名成员互相攻击的批判

say.text: 对这个重构计划做交叉批判,用 hyperplan
say.note: 只保留通过攻击的结论再成稿

say.text: 这个架构决策要最高严谨度,走 hyperplan
say.note: 最后由专门规划器输出正式方案

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member adversarial team that cross-critiques your topic; only defensible insights survive, then a dedicated planner writes the formal plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or you ask for a hyperplan / adversarial / cross-critique plan. Requires the omo-senpi team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to adversarially review this launch plan.
I want a cross-critique of this refactor plan — run hyperplan.
This architecture decision needs maximum rigor — use hyperplan.
say_en.note: A dedicated planner writes the final plan.
